goal: Load ColdLion sales-order and production-order history into the existing coldlion.* landing tables, one fixed 7-day window and one scope at a time, atomically and resumably from ledger evidence, with the vendor's silent page cap, malformed error contract and stage scoping handled explicitly rather than assumed away.
prohibited_actions: Do not change the shared database structure. This work loads rows into landing tables that already exist; a schema change is a separate governed migration and no supabase/migrations file may be authored here.
Do not write to any database from this session, and do not run either loader against a live target. The workflows are the only sanctioned execution path and they are dispatch/schedule only.
Do not commit any real ColdLion payload, order, item, customer or vendor value. This repository is public and the fixtures must be synthetic.
Do not build sync-masters.mjs. The owner asked about sales orders and production orders; the masters half of Step 7 is out of scope.
Do not retire, rewrite or carry another session's handoff file in this change.
assumptions: The migration schema of 2026-09-05 is the authority for identity, constraints and column names, ahead of the 2026-08-19 field-decisions CSV, because owner decisions D14/D17 of 2026-09-01 and the 2026-09-01 API additions post-date that CSV.
The loader owns its own transaction boundary, so it uses its own psql invocation rather than the shared helper that forces --single-transaction on one path and no transaction on the other.

The database target is supplied as an explicit secret. No pooler hostname is assembled from a project ref, because a guessed host is how a sandbox assumption reached production in the 2026-07-17 outage.
stop_conditions: Stop if the work would require a schema change; that is a separate governed migration.
Stop if a real ColdLion value would have to be committed to prove something.
Stop if the offline test suite cannot pass without secrets or database contact, rather than weakening the tests to make them green.
Stop before running either loader against any live database.
